body:
Closes #85

PO-authorized bounded reuse made the four missing symbols load through the fixed
public API. The resumed evaluation stops on a frozen independent Main expectation
mismatch: AP2112K pin4 is official/generated `no_connect`, while the expectation
recorded public-cache fallback `passive`. Post-generation oracle corrections are
prohibited. The unfinished PCB checker also misidentifies the NPTH enum. No Main
route was launched; initial/confirmation/transport counts remain **0/0/0**.

The initial selected-library shortage STOP is retained as an intermediate record,
with all 115 old EDA-004G files hash-preserved. Neither STOP demonstrates method-wide
infeasibility or mandatory large custom implementation. PR remains Draft/under
PMO review. No merge, adoption, Human Gate, product start or Issue-close action.

| Stage | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Four scoped definitions/roles/correspondence publicly loaded and read by KiCad. Versioned expectations frozen before generation. Complete Main typed-role acceptance FAIL at AP2112K pin4; four required fault injections NOT ENTERED. |
| 2 | Fresh source individually reconciled:49 parts/37 nets/197 pads(167 required+30 NC)/2 NPTH. Public Main schematic/unrouted PCB generated/read; raw ERC0 errors/83 warnings. Earlier PCB DRC0 target violations/237 warnings, before final nanometre rounding; no final-file DRC pass claimed. Full independent KiCad parity/copper acceptance UNQUALIFIED. |
| 3 | Effective .20mm violation test and DSN/SES retention NOT ENTERED. Stored rule values insufficient. |
| 4 | Initial Main NOT ENTERED (0 attempts). No route settings/DSN/SES/routed PCB. |
| 5 | Conditional confirmation NOT ENTERED (0 attempts). Whole-environment rebuild UNQUALIFIED. |

Evidence: [report](docs/native-main-routing-qualification.md),
[new epoch](hardware/kicad/qualification/eda-004g/resume-01/README.md), versioned
four-part/Main contracts, all generated inputs/outputs, raw process logs/hashes,
original failed variants, typed-pin diagnosis and terminal stop. Status/history and
Dashboard are synchronized; PR #84 remains merged/accepted historical evidence.

Corrections before STOP are disclosed: public method/layer enum names, grid-aligned
schematic positions, source oval paste, nanometre rounding, and non-electric private
annotation syntax in two official input symbols. No generated-file handpatch,
fork/private API/general writer, placement/connectivity/copper repair or historical
routed copper reuse. The executor did not establish full Stage1 readiness before
Main generation; generated files therefore do not imply qualified Stage2.

Remaining limits: UX metal/internal EP disposition and manufacturing, auxiliary
paste/marking parity, library warnings/registration, incomplete actual-copper reader,
required negative tests, effective clearance, transfer, routes and reconstruction.
Public cache fallback/serializer compatibility, inherited pin semantics, versioned
SWIG enums and unvalidated polygon connectivity need review. No measured engineer
implementation effort or mandatory-large-work estimate is asserted.

Original six-hour clock/cutoffs maintained (01:17:56 start;06:47:56 experiment
cutoff;07:17:56 submission deadline). Resume experiments02:48:37–03:35:11.510027,
46m34.510s wall; reporting and the required one-hour checkpoint recorded separately.
Prior cumulative AI estimates3.286h and earlier allowance4.036h retained; active
engineer/human/review time unknown. Waiting/command elapsed/estimates are separated;
budget not reset. Stopped early, preserving the last30m for reporting.

Submission checks:115 old evidence hashes, both frozen contracts, raw process/artifact
hashes and exact library archives; Python AST, TSX/JavaScript syntax, Dashboard
semantic scope/PR84 and git diff --check. These are submission checks, not technical
Main PASS or substitutes for the four NOT ENTERED fault injections.

Latest HEAD CI checked at **2026-10-14T03:51:19.384961+00:00**: `bf3d7eb56a2d8f82a52aff23e77761f36ee053be`, [engineering-ci run](https://github.com/ihsinoky/he-piantor-42/actions/runs/38508288745) completed SUCCESS. `Detect engineering changes` and `Engineering gate`: SUCCESS. `Layout generator`, `KiCad ERC / DRC`, `Sensor-test firmware`: SKIPPED. Management success/skipped engineering are **not technical Main PASS**. PR remains Draft/OPEN, auto-merge null.

Submission observation: original start-to-now wall 153.39 minutes, including turn waiting; resume/report/submission wall 62.71 minutes. These are clocks, not measured engineer-hours, and retain the original 6h cutoff.
